description: The second largest off-shore island flanked by the Third and Grand Bocas. Historically, it was the base of a leprosarium settlement, a plantation economy, a whaling station and a US naval base. The highlight of tours to the island include a salt water and the ruins of the Leprosarium. Listed opening hours: 24 hours. Verify access, opening times and any fees with the site before travelling.
